name: upande-cloud
description: Upande Cloud monorepo — root scripts for local development

scripts.postinstall: node scripts/setup-env.js && npm install --prefix apps/api && npm install --prefix apps/dashboard && npm install --prefix apps/admin
scripts.infra: docker compose up -d --wait postgres && bash scripts/dns-bootstrap.sh && docker compose up -d
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && cross-env PRISMA_ENGINES_MIRROR=https://cdn.npmmirror.com/binaries/prisma npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.prestart: npm run infra && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,dashboard,admin -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix apps/api" "npm run dev --prefix apps/dashboard" "npm run dev --prefix apps/admin"
